CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit presentation/layout statement, and an origin/status entry are present and bound to p0/current/n0, satisfying C, O and D.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition is explicitly linked to any identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names contents (red/blue sets) and lists their coordinate attributes at specified current and candidate times.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata entries (origin=...) are listed separately from the identified content coordinates, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: The text states the grid presentation rule and provides coordinate sets for contents, describing how contents are presented/organized at current time.
